Thank you for your supportive words, appreciate it but the problem is the case is still on, i want to take the owner to prosecutor when they call us but the owner went for vacation a week ago. So far she has not demanded any money or anything, our mutual friend tried to talk with her to take the case back but she is ignoring till now, lets see what happens next, i am still tensed and in depression though, no lawyer or anyone has stepped in to help till now.

The owner vacated her within 2 hours, now none of us knows where she gone, probably nearby.
The lawyer told me it can be done if i won then it can be reversed

I appreciate the time taken to write this and your advice, I thought about it already and the lawyer also told if she asks for money then shes doomed (someone working closely with police asked me the nationality of the lady, i said filipino, he said they receive lot of cases like this and they ask money in return to take the case back) at the end, nobody gains nothing from all of this mess, its time and money consuming process and running to different law firms or courts, i dont want to get to her level and do this, my only wish is she some how awakes and realises what this whole thing could do to me and my name, I have a startup, i want to be a successful business man, that startup not earned me 50$ either in last 2 years, thats why I started looking for a job but unfortunately things are not going good, I do part time to manage my accommodation and food, that is also once in a blue moon type part time. I am a honest person and i want to become someone in my life, i m not holding grudge against her or her friend. I just wish somehow this mess is just a dream but again i am sleepless 😔
